artworks.title: Female Satyr Nursing a Child in a Wooded Landscape
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 12.8 x 12.6 cm (5 1/16 x 4 15/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Bert Freidus
artworks.description: Two children and a woman are depicted in the image. The woman is sitting on a rock holding a child against her chest. Beside them, another child is standing and gesturing with one hand. They are surrounded by lush foliage, with a small clearing or pathway in the background.

artworks.title: Young Satyr at the Bank of a Stream
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 12.9 x 12.8 cm (5 1/16 x 5 1/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Bert Freidus
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure sitting on a rocky bank near water. In the background, there is a detailed landscape with trees, hills, and foliage. The drawing shows hatching and cross-hatching techniques used to create texture and depth in the landscape and contrast in the rocky surfaces and the figure’s skin.

artworks.title: Galley Slave Hauling a Ship's Cargo
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 12.9 x 12.7 cm (5 1/16 x 5 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Bert Freidus
artworks.description: The image shows a laborer rolling a large barrel on a cobblestone pavement near the water's edge. Two masted ships are docked in the distance, with tall masts reaching into the sky. A cylindrical tower structure and a few buildings are nearby, suggesting an urban coastal setting. The horizon is high, with ships and distant landforms visible against it. The artist uses intricate etching techniques to convey shadow and texture, with a monochromatic palette emphasizing light and dark contrasts. The scene depicts a moment of industrious activity in a port setting.

artworks.title: Seaport with Two Turkish Merchants
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 13.1 x 12.6 cm (5 3/16 x 4 15/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Bert Freidus
artworks.description: The image depicts an etching showing two men sitting on what seems to be sacks or bales, looking out towards the sea. The horizon is visible halfway up the image, featuring ships on calm waters. The etching displays intricate line work with cross-hatching for shadows and texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with black lines on light paper, conveying a sense of calm and contemplation.

artworks.title: Near Gravesend: Souvenir of the Thames
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, and roulette on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection
artworks.description: The image displays a nautical scene with a harbor, boats, and people on a shore. The depiction shows a sailing ship with full sails on the water, alongside smaller boats. People are seen near moored boats, with one individual seeming to operate a piece of machinery. The artwork uses fine etching lines to denote movement in the water and sky, and features a monochromatic color scheme of sepia and dark browns.

artworks.title: Baptismal commemoration for Jean Buhot (Baptême japonais)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint, and liftground in black and brown (proof) on parchment
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection
artworks.description: The image consists of an arrangement with a central oval depiction of a child, surrounded by owls in the upper right section. The color palette includes shades of grey, creating a monochromatic appearance. The child's portrait is in the upper left, with the owls positioned slightly to the right of the center. Below the portrait, vases and partially visible books with a mix of sketches and letters are scattered on a flat surface. The scene presents a layered impression with various textures and elements blending into each other.

artworks.title: Akt mit hochgehobenem Hemd (Woman Undressing)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Toni G. Marcy
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a portion of a person's upper torso and head. The person is reclining with one arm bent upwards and the other crossing the body. The face is sketchily depicted with indications of eyes, a nose, and a mouth, and short, tousled hair. There is no detailed clothing shown. The background consists of abstract lines and shading. In the lower right corner, there is a signature.

artworks.title: Verschiedene Bilnisstudien (Portrait Sketches)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Toni G. Marcy
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch showing multiple figures in various positions, capturing mostly head and upper body views. In the upper portion, a person is depicted reclining with eyes closed and head leaning back. In the center, a figure appears with closed eyes and a gentle smile. To the left, another figure sits with their head tilted down, eyes closed. In the lower right corner, a small figure is seen in profile, looking toward the center. The sketch is created with flowing lines outlining the figures and features, with touches of hatching in the background. There are no evident objects or jewelry, and the background remains simple. The artwork is signed at the bottom right with a flowing cursive signature.

artworks.title: Walchensee im Nebel (Walchensee in Fog)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Toni G. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a wide scene with mountains, a lake, and a sky. The viewpoint appears to be from an elevated position looking out across the landscape. The composition includes rugged mountain peaks meeting the sky, with loose and sketch-like brushstrokes creating movement and texture. The color palette is monochromatic with deep grays, blacks, and whites, resembling charcoal or pencil on paper. The foreground features suggested bare trees and bushes, leading to lighter shaded mountains in the distance, conveying depth.

artworks.title: Ruhende Dreiviertel Akt (Reclining Female Nude)
artworks.medium: softground etching in black on Strathmore laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Toni G. Marcy
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a seated woman from the upper thighs upwards. She is reclining with her torso leaning to the left, head tilted back, and resting against her right hand. Her face features a slightly open mouth, closed eyes, and shoulder-length wavy hair. The woman is unclothed, with her right leg bent underneath her and her upper body angled to show her torso. She is not wearing any jewelry or holding any objects. The background is minimal, with a textured backdrop suggesting an interior space and simple shading for shadows. The artist's signature is visible at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Thomas Corinth
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Toni G. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person seated, featuring the upper half of their body. The person has defined facial features such as prominent cheekbones and a straight nose, with short hair. They are wearing a garment with a collar, possibly a shirt or jacket. The sketch has minimalistic details with fluid lines, focusing on the person's facial expression and posture. The background is plain, with a signature at the lower part of the image.

artworks.title: The Return of the Prodigal Son
artworks.medium: pen and brown iron gall ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Diane Allen Nixon and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a line drawing depicting two full-body figures embracing. The person on the left appears to be an older man, with a long beard and flowing hair, wearing a robe that drapes around him. His facial features are somewhat obscured due to the beard. The person on the right has long, wavy hair and appears to be younger, wearing a simple, slightly ragged tunic and skirt, and is barefoot. Both figures are barefoot. They are positioned close together, with the younger figure leaning inward, seemingly pressing their faces together. The surroundings are minimalistic, with only a few lines suggesting a step or low platform, leaving a plain background that emphasizes the interaction between the two figures.

artworks.title: Head of a Magician
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper (still mounted on original Tiepolo album page)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Christian Aall
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a person in profile view, showcasing the head and a portion of the neck. The person has distinct facial characteristics, including a notable nose and furrowed brow. The lower face features a textured beard and mustache. The sketch shows a form resembling a cloth or headpiece covering the head. There is a suggestion of draped fabric that might be a collar or scarf. The sketch is created in a monochromatic palette with ink or sepia tones on a textured paper surface. The background is plain, with no visible objects or jewelry in the image.

artworks.title: Palatial Mantelpiece with Mercury and Hope [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (folded): 31.2 x 20.3 cm (12 5/16 x 8 in.)
overall (unfolded): 31.2 x 41.1 cm (12 5/16 x 16 3/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Mark J. Millard Architectural Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural design. The drawing depicts an elaborate architectural structure featuring various classical motifs. The structure is richly detailed, showcasing columns topped with intricate capitals, and panels filled with a combination of scrollwork, foliage, and possibly mythical creatures or figures. There are prominent human figures or sculptures integrated into the design, resembling caryatids or decorative statuary. These elements are complemented by additional embellishments like garlands and relief work. The drawing is executed with precise line work and is annotated with a date to the side “A.D.O.M. 1577”.

artworks.title: A Standing Apostle Holding a Book
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper, lightly washed pink
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sharon Greer Phillips in memory of her husband Neil Franklyn Phillips
artworks.description: The image features an elderly man standing barefoot with a bent posture, holding a book close to his chest. He has a broad face, pronounced cheekbones, furrowed brows, curly hair, and a beard. He wears a tunic and stands on a square block with scattered stones around. The top right corner is marked "1514" and contains initials.

artworks.title: J.C. Erhard
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on a rustic wooden bench, engrossed in writing or drawing on a notebook. He has a soft facial profile, straight nose, and is wearing a cap and a long coat. A bag is draped over the back of the bench, and he holds a pipe in his right hand. The background features natural scenery with branches and leaves, hinting at an outdoor setting, possibly a garden or nature reserve. Faint mountains or hills are visible in the far distance.

artworks.title: Shepherd Boy with Two Goats
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting on grass with their legs crossed. They are leaning against a wooden fence, wearing a wide-brimmed hat, long-sleeved shirt, and a buttoned vest. The person has shoulder-length hair, slightly narrow eyes, and a solemn expression. They hold a stick in their right hand. Two goats are nearby, one standing and the other lying down. The background includes leafy trees and a partly cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Cossack Horses in a Courtyard
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse inside a courtyard. The scene includes a single saddled horse standing near an archway. The courtyard has stone walls and the ground has foliage and scattered stones. The drawing style is intricate and detailed.

artworks.title: Ansicht von St. Helena und des Schlosses Rauhenstein bey Baden
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape sketch with a detailed view from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is placed above the middle of the image, with ruins of a castle on a cliff surrounded by trees. The style features precise linework typical of etching techniques, capturing details of cliffs, foliage, and buildings. The monochromatic scheme emphasizes textures. In the foreground, there are cows grazing near water and a figure tending to them, with a winding path. In the distance, there are rolling hills and a small village with a spired building.

artworks.title: Pompe funèbre de Catherine Opalinska
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in memory of Neil Phillips
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornately decorated interior space. It features intricate details like decorated walls, hanging drapery, and multiple tiers of candles or lamps providing light. In the center, there is a large, ornate canopy or baldachin under which rests a sculptural element. This structure is surrounded by rows of seating or gathering areas and framed by tall columns and detailed architectural features. The scene conveys a sense of grandeur and elegance within a ceremonial context.

artworks.title: Pompe funèbre de Polixène de Hesse-Rhinfels
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in memory of Neil Phillips
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a richly decorated room set up for a ceremonial event. The style is reminiscent of 18th-century European engravings. The image features an opulent catafalque adorned with sculptures, fabric, and candelabras in the center. The walls and ceiling are decorated with reliefs and motifs, leading towards an altar in the background. Attendees are seated on benches along the walls, accompanied by figures in ceremonial attire. The artwork conveys a sense of depth and grandeur, creating an atmosphere of solemnity and regal presence.

artworks.title: Pompe funèbre d'Élisabeth Therèse de Lorraine
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in memory of Neil Phillips
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate ceremonial setting within a grand architectural interior. The scene features a large hall adorned with drapery and decorative elements. Above, there is a canopy with fabric and sculptures. In the center is an elevated platform with a decorated structure and candelabras. The hall is flanked by columns and pilasters, with detailed draperies and symbols on the walls. The perspective is designed to emphasize the height and expanse of the space, directing the viewer's eye towards the center of the scene.

artworks.title: Le Perruquier fatigué (The Tired Wigmaker)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a seated person with both legs visible, slouched forward with their head resting on their arms on a table. The person's facial features show a weary expression, short curled hair, and they are wearing a loose gown. Nearby objects include a hat, pair of scissors, and a brush on the floor. On the cluttered table are a candlestick with a burning candle, a large mirror, a head form with a wig, and a bowl. The background features a tiled floor meeting two walls at a corner, creating a simple indoor setting for the chair and table.

artworks.title: Gaspar Gribolari Brocanteur à Padoüe (Gaspar Gribolari, Secondhand Dealer in Padua)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a person standing upright. The person has a rounded face with plump cheeks, small deep-set eyes, short curly hair, and is wearing a long coat over a suit with a buttoned waistcoat and knee-breeches. They have shoes with buckles and hold a tricorn hat and a bundle of papers or a book under one arm. There are no noticeable pieces of jewelry. In the background on the right, there is an ornate stone fountain with a lion's head, and on the left side, there is a simple building with smoke coming from its chimney. The foreground includes some sparse vegetation on the ground.
